## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

installer of geosynthetic materials for a broad range of environmental containment applications,

provider to customers in the power, solid waste, mining, and agriculture industries, gaining a
reputation as the best geosynthetic installer in the trade.

customers. Our slitting, seaming and re-rolling capabilities enable us to tailor products to fit
exact needs and specifications, while our large, centrally located facility allows guaranteed quick
shipments to any destination. In addition to our well-trained, Midwest-based customer service
professionals, we have product specialists located throughout the United States. Whatever your needs
or wherever your site is located, GSI is positioned to serve you.

## [Geotextile Tubes][85]

GSI manufactures GEOSTRUX™ Geotextile Tubes for use in a wide variety of projects where dewatering
of sediments and industrial wastes is required. These applications include coal ash ponds,
industrial sludge and sediments, mining tailings, wastewater treatment plant sludge, organic and
inorganic materials, and silts and sands. We also support environmental construction efforts such as
Superfund sites where the EPA manages environmental contamination cleanup projects, as well as
dredging contractors who require efficient dewatering.

[Learn More][86]
[[Geotextile Tubes]][87]

## A Leader in the Industry

GSI is one of the country’s largest independent installers of geotextile liners for landfill sites
and manages installation projects in all parts of the country. Additionally, with its GEOSTRUX™
Geotextile Tubes, GSI has supported sediment cleanup projects on waterways throughout the United
States. GSI is an authorized distributor for many of the most recognized names of geosynthetic
materials and erosion control products. GSI provides effective and responsive product distribution
to landscape, environmental engineering and general contractors from its distribution facility in
Waukesha, Wisconsin.

Geo-Synthetics Systems LLC (GSI) is committed to safety in collaboration with quality, service and
customer satisfaction. The GSI Safety Policy is achieved through continuous awareness and commitment
to safety, starting with the orientation of any new GSI employee and ending only when they return
safely from work every day. GSI, therefore, endorses and requires a concept of safety based on the
principle that it is the basic responsibility of each department and employee of the company.

## Why Choose GSI?

When it comes to environmental containment, GSI does it all. We are a distributor, fabricator, and
installer of geosynthetic materials for a broad range of environmental containment applications,
including erosion control and contamination clean-up. For over 40 years, we have been a trusted
provider to customers in the power, solid waste, mining, and agriculture industries, gaining a
reputation as the best geosynthetic installer in the trade.

[Learn More][78]

## [Construction Materials & Fabrics][79]

GSI’s construction products focus on finding lasting environmental containment solutions for our
customers. Our slitting, seaming and re-rolling capabilities enable us to tailor products to fit
exact needs and specifications, while our large, centrally located facility allows guaranteed quick
shipments to any destination. In addition to our well-trained, Midwest-based customer service
professionals, we have product specialists located throughout the United States. Whatever your needs
or wherever your site is located, GSI is positioned to serve you.

[Learn More][80]
[[Construction Materials & Fabrics]][81]
[[Liner & Installation Services]][82]

## [Liner & Installation Services][83]

GSI is one of the largest installers of geotextile liners in the USA. Our installation services have
been utilized by a wide range of industries, including landfills, power and energy, civil
construction, EPA and Corp. of Engineers projects, pulp and paper, oil and gas, aquaculture,
agriculture and mining. GSI’s estimating, project management and construction operations are all
based in Waukesha, Wisconsin. Our installation crews operate from locations across the country,
enabling us to provide competitive local service from coast to coast.

[Learn More][84]

## [Geotextile Tubes][85]

GSI manufactures GEOSTRUX™ Geotextile Tubes for use in a wide variety of projects where dewatering
of sediments and industrial wastes is required. These applications include coal ash ponds,
industrial sludge and sediments, mining tailings, wastewater treatment plant sludge, organic and
inorganic materials, and silts and sands. We also support environmental construction efforts such as
Superfund sites where the EPA manages environmental contamination cleanup projects, as well as
dredging contractors who require efficient dewatering.

[Learn More][86]
[[Geotextile Tubes]][87]

## A Leader in the Industry

GSI is one of the country’s largest independent installers of geotextile liners for landfill sites
and manages installation projects in all parts of the country. Additionally, with its GEOSTRUX™
Geotextile Tubes, GSI has supported sediment cleanup projects on waterways throughout the United
States. GSI is an authorized distributor for many of the most recognized names of geosynthetic
materials and erosion control products. GSI provides effective and responsive product distribution
to landscape, environmental engineering and general contractors from its distribution facility in
Waukesha, Wisconsin.

continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

Solution Design

ABG provides innovative, trusted and carbon saving geosynthetic design solutions to meet a diverse
range of global engineering challenges.

[Design Solutions][161]
Landfill & Environmental

ABG's geosynthetic composites are at the forefront of gas, leachate and groundwater drainage in
landfill lining and capping systems throughout the world.

[Environmental Drainage][162]
Blue Roof & Green
Roof Systems

At ABG we offer a complete blue and green roof solution, from design through to installation.

[Blue & Green Roofing][163]
Structural Drainage

ABG manufacture and supply a wide range of structural drainage layers to alleviate hydrostatic
pressure, control groundwater and manage surface water.

[Structural Drainage][164]
Highways & Rail

A range of geosynthetics for use in transport applications; from carriageway / trackside drainage to
embankment consolidation and subbase reinforcement.

[Highways & Rail][165]
Tunnels

Tunnel drainage is made easier with Cavidrain®; a high performance composite for drainage of tunnel
walls and inverts.

[Tunnels][166]
Earthworks Drainage

A complete range of products for geotechnical applications including drainage, ground improvement

* ### CCR APPLICATIONS
  
  ## Beating the New Challenges of CCR
  
  The EPA’s ruling on the disposal of coal combustion residuals has defined the standard for
  successful containment and closure of coal combustion residuals (CCR) facilities. Since then, AGRU
  America has been committed to becoming the supplier of choice for CCR-related applications.
  
  Discover industry-leading geosynthetics specially designed for the closure and containment of CCR.
  Manufactured to meet even the most stringent project parameters, AGRU’s products provide
  state-of-the-art solutions for CCR impoundments and landfills.
  
  [LEARN MORE][79]
* ### ENERGY, OIL & GAS
  
  ## Unparalleled Benefits for Energy & Oil
  
  Manufactured using the flat die calendered extrusion process, AGRU America’s HDPE and LLDPE
  geomembranes deliver numerous benefits including containment, stability, chemical resistance, and
  cost savings. All AGRU geomembranes, geocomposites, geotextiles, geonets, geosynthetic clay
  liners, and other geosynthetic materials are manufactured in the U.S. and meet stringent quality
  control standards.
  
  These geomembranes and geosynthetic products offer unparalleled benefits for energy, oil, and gas
  applications.
  
  [LEARN MORE][80]
* ### ENVIRONMENTAL
  
  ## The Highest Degree of Containment
  
  When it comes to the environment, it pays to use the best waste management solutions available. As
  the industry-leading producer of geosynthetics in North America, AGRU America and its flat die
  calendered extrusion process delivers the highest and most consistent quality geomembrane and
  geosynthetic products for environmental applications. Our products are the perfect solution for
  applications requiring the highest degree of containment, stability, chemical resistance, and
  erosion prevention.
  
  [LEARN MORE][81]

  Whether you need leak detection or filtration, look to AGRU’s Geocomposite and Geonet products.

## Infrastructure for a Sustainable Future

### [View Products][76] | [Review Projects][77] | [Contact Us][78]
* ### CCR APPLICATIONS
  
  ## Beating the New Challenges of CCR
  
  The EPA’s ruling on the disposal of coal combustion residuals has defined the standard for
  successful containment and closure of coal combustion residuals (CCR) facilities. Since then, AGRU
  America has been committed to becoming the supplier of choice for CCR-related applications.
  
  Discover industry-leading geosynthetics specially designed for the closure and containment of CCR.
  Manufactured to meet even the most stringent project parameters, AGRU’s products provide
  state-of-the-art solutions for CCR impoundments and landfills.
  
  [LEARN MORE][79]
* ### ENERGY, OIL & GAS
  
  ## Unparalleled Benefits for Energy & Oil
  
  Manufactured using the flat die calendered extrusion process, AGRU America’s HDPE and LLDPE
  geomembranes deliver numerous benefits including containment, stability, chemical resistance, and
  cost savings. All AGRU geomembranes, geocomposites, geotextiles, geonets, geosynthetic clay
  liners, and other geosynthetic materials are manufactured in the U.S. and meet stringent quality
  control standards.
  
  These geomembranes and geosynthetic products offer unparalleled benefits for energy, oil, and gas
  applications.
  
  [LEARN MORE][80]
* ### ENVIRONMENTAL
  
  ## The Highest Degree of Containment
  
  When it comes to the environment, it pays to use the best waste management solutions available. As
  the industry-leading producer of geosynthetics in North America, AGRU America and its flat die
  calendered extrusion process delivers the highest and most consistent quality geomembrane and
  geosynthetic products for environmental applications. Our products are the perfect solution for
  applications requiring the highest degree of containment, stability, chemical resistance, and
  erosion prevention.
  
  [LEARN MORE][81]
* [][82]
  
  ### GEOMEMBRANES
  
  Manufactured HDPE & LLDPE using patented processes for better containment.
* [][83]
  
  ### CLOSURETURF®
  
  Subtitle-D compliant final cover system that can be installed more than 50% faster.
* [][84]
  
  ### CLOSURE SOLUTIONS
  
  Proven systems for embankments, waterways, landfills, mine spoils, and hazardous sites.
* [][85]
  
  ### DRAINAGE SOLUTIONS
  
  Whether you need leak detection or filtration, look to AGRU’s Geocomposite and Geonet products.
* [][86]
  
  ### AGRULINE PIPE AND FITTINGS
  
  Made from PE-100 for excellent durability and corrosion- and abrasion-resistance.
* [][87]
  
  ### CONCRETE PROTECTION
  
  For protection and lining of concrete structures, including tunnels, potable water tanks, and
  pipes.
* [][88]
  
  ### SEMI-FINISHED SOLUTIONS
  
  Round bars, welding rods and plastic sheets on our state-of-the-art production systems.
* [][89]
  
  ### GEOSYNTHETIC CLAY LINERS
  
  Offers superior protection of other critical materials from puncture, migration or degradation.

## ABOUT US

## Welcome to A&T Geosynthetics!

A&T Geosynthetics, we are dedicated to provide high-quality geosynthetic products that meet the
diverse needs of our clients in the infrastructure and environmental sectors. As a leading
manufacturer and exporter based in India, we specialize in a range of innovative solutions designed
to enhance the performance and longevity of infrastructure projects

## A&T Geosynthetics

We’re passionate about strengthening your projects with our top-notch geosynthetic products. As a
leading manufacturer, we provide a diverse range of geosynthetic products, including Geostrip
(ATSTRIP), Nonwoven Geotextile (ATGTX), Drainage Geocomposite (ATDRAIN), Geocell (ATWEB), and
Geogrid (ATGRID).

## A&T Geosynthetics

Our commitment to quality means that every product is designed to meet the highest engineering
standards. Together, let's build a future that stands strong.

[ Previous ][13] [ Next ][14]

## OUR Products

##### HDPE Geocell
##### ATWEB

Brings unmatched strength and versatility, the unique system features heavy duty polymeric strips
that are ultrasonically welded into a robust honeycomb structure, providing exceptional confinement.

[Read More][15]

##### Drainage Geocomposite –
##### ATDRAIN

The innovative Geocomposite drain, crafted by expertly layering a robust geonet drainage core
between two protective geotextile layers, it stands out with its optional geomembrane enhancement.

[Read More][16]

##### Geogrid Biaxial –
##### ATGRID PP

Are integrally formed biaxial geogrids manufactured from superior grades of UV stabilized
polypropylene using precisely controlled extrusion, punching, and drawing processes.

[Read More][17]

##### Nonwoven Geotextile –
##### ATGTX

ATGTX is nonwoven polypropylene geotextile made with PP staple yarns which are thermally bonded
through needle punching to form a strong, flexible and dimensionally stable fabric structure with
optimum pore sizes and high permeability.

[Read More][18]

##### Geostrip –
##### ATSTRIP

ATSTRIPS are geosynthetic strips comprise tendons of polyester yarns encased in a polyethylene
sheath. Specifically engineered for the reinforcement of soils and other fills for the construction
of reinforced soil walls.

[Read More][19]

## WHY choose us?

##### High-Quality Products

We deliver durable, high-performance geosynthetic products for infrastructure and environmental
projects.

##### Experienced Team

Skilled professionals ensuring high-quality geosynthetic product manufacturing and service.

##### Sustainable Approach

Environmentally conscious manufacturing processes
focused on long-term sustainability.

##### Cost Effective Solutions

Affordable, value-driven products tailored to meet project requirements efficiently.

##### Production Capacity

With a production capacity of 350 tonnes per month, we ensure timely delivery.

##### Timely Delivery

Reliable and punctual delivery for seamless project progress and client satisfaction

The innovative Geocomposite drain, crafted by expertly layering a robust geonet drainage core
between two protective geotextile layers, it stands out with its optional geomembrane enhancement.

[Read More][16]

##### Geogrid Biaxial –
##### ATGRID PP

Are integrally formed biaxial geogrids manufactured from superior grades of UV stabilized
polypropylene using precisely controlled extrusion, punching, and drawing processes.

[Read More][17]

##### Nonwoven Geotextile –
##### ATGTX

ATGTX is nonwoven polypropylene geotextile made with PP staple yarns which are thermally bonded
through needle punching to form a strong, flexible and dimensionally stable fabric structure with
optimum pore sizes and high permeability.

[Read More][18]

##### Geostrip –
##### ATSTRIP

ATSTRIPS are geosynthetic strips comprise tendons of polyester yarns encased in a polyethylene
sheath. Specifically engineered for the reinforcement of soils and other fills for the construction
of reinforced soil walls.

[Read More][19]

focused on long-term sustainability.

[Geomembrane][76]
Geomembrane is a synthetic polymer barrier made of high-performance materials such as HDPE or PVC,
typically ranging from 0.2mm to 3mm, with excellent durability and resistance to puncture, UV
radiation, and chemicals. It can effectively prevent the movement of fluids and gases, which is
crucial for preventing leaks in landfills, reservoirs, mining, and agriculture. By installing
through hot welding, ensures safe enclosure and contributes to environmental protection and
sustainable infrastructure.
[ DISCOVER MORE ][77]
[Geotextile][78]
Geotextile is permeable geosynthetic fabrics crafted from polyester or polypropylene to separate,
filter, reinforce, and stabilize soil. They enhance soil strength and prevent erosion, playing a
crucial role in civil engineering projects such as roads, railroads, and erosion control systems.
Improve drainage, reduce structural support needs, and offer a durable, cost-effective solution.
Their flexibility facilitates installation across various terrains, and they can be customized for
specific project needs.
[ DISCOVER MORE ][79]
[Geogrid][80]
Geogrid is geosynthetic made from polymers like polypropylene or polyester, designed to reinforce
soil and improve stability. Their grid-like structures provide high tensile strength, enhance soil
bearing capacity, and reduce settlement by distributing loads over a larger area. They promote
effective drainage and soil interlocking, offering excellent durability and resistance to
environmental factors. This enhances the performance and longevity of civil engineering projects,
making geogrids ideal for road construction, retaining walls, and slope stabilization.

[Geosynthetic Clay Liner][82]
Geosynthetic Clay Liner (GCL) is a composite barrier material made of natural sodium bentonite clay
encapsulated between woven and nonwoven geotextiles, offering excellent self-sealing, low
permeability, durability, and chemical resistance. With a typical thickness of 5–8 mm, mass per unit
area of 4000–6000 g/m², and roll sizes up to 6 m × 40 m, it is lightweight, easy to install, and
more cost-effective than compacted clay. GCL is widely applied in landfills, mining, reservoirs,
canals, and other containment projects to provide reliable seepage control and groundwater
protection.
[ DISCOVER MORE ][83]

[Geomembrane][76]
Geomembrane is a synthetic polymer barrier made of high-performance materials such as HDPE or PVC,
typically ranging from 0.2mm to 3mm, with excellent durability and resistance to puncture, UV
radiation, and chemicals. It can effectively prevent the movement of fluids and gases, which is
crucial for preventing leaks in landfills, reservoirs, mining, and agriculture. By installing
through hot welding, ensures safe enclosure and contributes to environmental protection and
sustainable infrastructure.
[ DISCOVER MORE ][77]
[Geotextile][78]
Geotextile is permeable geosynthetic fabrics crafted from polyester or polypropylene to separate,
filter, reinforce, and stabilize soil. They enhance soil strength and prevent erosion, playing a
crucial role in civil engineering projects such as roads, railroads, and erosion control systems.
Improve drainage, reduce structural support needs, and offer a durable, cost-effective solution.
Their flexibility facilitates installation across various terrains, and they can be customized for
specific project needs.
[ DISCOVER MORE ][79]
[Geogrid][80]
Geogrid is geosynthetic made from polymers like polypropylene or polyester, designed to reinforce
soil and improve stability. Their grid-like structures provide high tensile strength, enhance soil
bearing capacity, and reduce settlement by distributing loads over a larger area. They promote
effective drainage and soil interlocking, offering excellent durability and resistance to
environmental factors. This enhances the performance and longevity of civil engineering projects,
making geogrids ideal for road construction, retaining walls, and slope stabilization.

[Geosynthetic Clay Liner][82]
Geosynthetic Clay Liner (GCL) is a composite barrier material made of natural sodium bentonite clay
encapsulated between woven and nonwoven geotextiles, offering excellent self-sealing, low
permeability, durability, and chemical resistance. With a typical thickness of 5–8 mm, mass per unit
area of 4000–6000 g/m², and roll sizes up to 6 m × 40 m, it is lightweight, easy to install, and
more cost-effective than compacted clay. GCL is widely applied in landfills, mining, reservoirs,
canals, and other containment projects to provide reliable seepage control and groundwater
protection.
[ DISCOVER MORE ][83]

## How to Check Company Status on MCA

The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) portal lets you verify any registered Indian company's
status in seconds — for free.
1. Visit **mca.gov.in** and click *MCA Services*
2. Select *View Company / LLP Master Data*
3. Enter the **CIN** (Corporate Identity Number) or company name
4. Click *Submit* to see the master data
5. Check the **Company Status** field in the results

**Active** — company is in good standing and filing compliances
**Struck Off** — removed from registry, cannot do business
**Under Liquidation** — winding-up proceedings ongoing
**Dissolved** — company formally closed and deregistered
You can also search any company instantly on **companydetails.in** without visiting MCA directly.

## How to Check Company Status on MCA

The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) portal lets you verify any registered Indian company's
status in seconds — for free.
1. Visit **mca.gov.in** and click *MCA Services*
2. Select *View Company / LLP Master Data*
3. Enter the **CIN** (Corporate Identity Number) or company name
4. Click *Submit* to see the master data
5. Check the **Company Status** field in the results

**Active** — company is in good standing and filing compliances
**Struck Off** — removed from registry, cannot do business
**Under Liquidation** — winding-up proceedings ongoing
**Dissolved** — company formally closed and deregistered
You can also search any company instantly on **companydetails.in** without visiting MCA directly.

## How to Verify a GST Number

A valid GSTIN (Goods & Services Tax Identification Number) confirms a business is registered to
collect GST. Always verify before making B2B payments.
1. Go to **gst.gov.in** — no login required
2. Click *Search Taxpayer* → *Search by GSTIN / UIN*
3. Enter the **15-character GSTIN** and solve the CAPTCHA
4. Check the **Registration Status** — must show *Active*
5. Verify the **Legal Name** matches your vendor/supplier

How to read a GSTIN
27 AABCU9603R 1 Z 5
■ State code ■ PAN (10) ■ Entity ■ Z ■ Check
A **cancelled** or **suspended** GSTIN means the business cannot charge GST — input tax credit
claims will be disallowed.

## Pvt Ltd vs LLP — Key Differences

Choosing the right business structure affects taxation, liability, compliance burden, and investor
readiness. Here's a quick comparison.

Factor           │Pvt Ltd                    │LLP                  
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Liability        │Limited                    │Limited              
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Min. Members     │2 directors, 2 shareholders│2 designated partners
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Tax Rate         │22% (base)                 │30% (flat)           
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Annual Filings   │Higher — ROC + IT + audit  │Lower — MCA + IT     
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Equity / VC      │✔ Allowed                  │✘ Not allowed        
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Foreign Ownership│✔ FDI allowed              │Limited routes       
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Startup India    │✔ Eligible                 │✔ Eligible           
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Cost to Set Up   │₹6,000–₹15,000             │₹3,000–₹8,000        
─────────────────┴───────────────────────────┴─────────────────────
Choose **Pvt Ltd** if you plan to raise funding. Choose **LLP** for professional services firms with
lower compliance needs.

# Downley engineering and market intelligence consultancy

[ [Downley Consultants logo] ][50]

Downley Consultants is a business and engineering consultancy focused on two dynamic and growing
fields of civil engineering:
* Geosynthetics
* Underground pipe network assessment and rehabilitation

In both sectors we provide our clients with professional expert advice on market and competitive
knowledge and intelligence, and engineering design, condition assessment and solutions to problems…

[Marketing information]

Our team of highly experienced leading industry experts provides high quality and high value advice
to inform clients on markets and to solve their technical and engineering problems in our fields of
expertise. Downley Consultants celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2022 and has supported and guided
hundreds of clients around the world successfully, cost-effectively and confidentially. We are proud
of our record of consistently very high client satisfaction throughout that period, reflected in the
high level of repeat business from satisfied clients.

Downley Consultants provides its clients with high-level strategic marketing and market intelligence
so that they can make key management decisions with confidence based on robust and reliable
knowledge of the markets and competitive landscape. We do so based on our extensive engineering
expertise and knowledge in these sectors; in geosynthetics conceptual and preliminary design,
solutions development and specification to achieve sustainable and economic structures; and in
underground utility networks inspection, condition assessment and rehabilitation to extend the
service life of valuable assets that cannot easily be replaced.

Over almost 30 years we have advised and supported our clients across many key activities:
* Global, regional & local market knowledge & research
* Competitive analysis of markets and key segments
* Strategic market analysis and evaluation of options
* Positioning for optimum competitive advantage
* Review and development of winning value propositions
*  Analysis & development of sustainable and economic engineering solutions with geosynthetics
* Inspection, engineering condition assessment and rehabilitation of underground utility networks
* Professional engineering design across all applications in both geosynthetics and underground
  network rehabilitation
* Asset management plans
* Performance- and prescriptive-based technical specifications

# Downley engineering and market intelligence consultancy

[ [Downley Consultants logo] ][50]

Downley Consultants is a business and engineering consultancy focused on two dynamic and growing
fields of civil engineering:
* Geosynthetics
* Underground pipe network assessment and rehabilitation

In both sectors we provide our clients with professional expert advice on market and competitive
knowledge and intelligence, and engineering design, condition assessment and solutions to problems…

[Marketing information]

Our team of highly experienced leading industry experts provides high quality and high value advice
to inform clients on markets and to solve their technical and engineering problems in our fields of
expertise. Downley Consultants celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2022 and has supported and guided
hundreds of clients around the world successfully, cost-effectively and confidentially. We are proud
of our record of consistently very high client satisfaction throughout that period, reflected in the
high level of repeat business from satisfied clients.

Downley Consultants provides its clients with high-level strategic marketing and market intelligence
so that they can make key management decisions with confidence based on robust and reliable
knowledge of the markets and competitive landscape. We do so based on our extensive engineering
expertise and knowledge in these sectors; in geosynthetics conceptual and preliminary design,
solutions development and specification to achieve sustainable and economic structures; and in
underground utility networks inspection, condition assessment and rehabilitation to extend the
service life of valuable assets that cannot easily be replaced.

Over almost 30 years we have advised and supported our clients across many key activities:
* Global, regional & local market knowledge & research
* Competitive analysis of markets and key segments
* Strategic market analysis and evaluation of options
* Positioning for optimum competitive advantage
* Review and development of winning value propositions
*  Analysis & development of sustainable and economic engineering solutions with geosynthetics
* Inspection, engineering condition assessment and rehabilitation of underground utility networks
* Professional engineering design across all applications in both geosynthetics and underground
  network rehabilitation
* Asset management plans
* Performance- and prescriptive-based technical specifications

#### Geotextile

A permeable fabric used to separate, filter, reinforce, protect, or drain soil in civil engineering
and environmental applications.
[Learn More][97]

#### Geomembrane

An impermeable synthetic liner used for containment and seepage control in landfills, ponds, and
wastewater treatment projects.
[Learn More][98]

#### Geogrid

Geogrids are high-strength geosynthetic materials made from polymers such as polypropylene (PP) or
high-density polyethylene (HDPE), designed specifically for soil reinforcement and stabilization. 
[Learn More][99]

#### Ground Protection Mat

A durable panel designed to distribute loads and stabilize the ground for roads, construction sites,
and temporary accessways.
[Learn More][100]

High-performance plastic materials engineered for strength, heat resistance, and durability in
industrial and structural applications.

#### Advantages and characteristics of geosynthetics

Geosynthetics are a broad category of synthetic products used in geotechnical and civil engineering
applications. They include materials such as **geomembranes, geotextiles, geogrids, geonets,
geocells,** and **geosynthetic clay liners (GCLs)**. These products offer multiple advantages that
enhance the performance, sustainability, and cost-efficiency of modern infrastructure projects.

[Why Choose Us][84]

[EcoGeoX Limited][85]

[EcoGeoX: Eco is the short term of Ecological, Geo is the prefix of Geosynthetics, X stands for the
different materials such as Geomembrane, Geotextile, Geogrid, Geocell, Geonet, Geocomposite, so on
and etc. EcoGeoX Geosynthetics manufactures & distributes & markets a wide range of Geosynthetics
products, including the Geomembrane, Geotextile, Geosynthetics Clay Liner (GCL), Geogrid, Geocell,
Geonet, Geocomposites, Geobag and Fiber etc. geosynthetics materials to international markets. We
have become a leader supplier for all requirements in the geosynthetics field, capable of offer our
customers a wide range of solutions. The experience acquired over the years, made our products range
complete, either for its wideness, reaching a high quality level and competitiveness. The steady
attention during production processing and a strict selection of the raw materials is our guarantee
of a full compliance with the market reference standards.][86]

[View More][87]

[Company News][88]
* [ [EcoGeoX Geomembrane for Mining & Industrial & Landfill & Pond Use] ][89]
  
  [EcoGeoX Geomembrane for Mining & Industrial & Landfill & Pond Use][90]
  
  [EcoGeoX Geomembrane acts as a critical impermeable barrier in primary and secondary landfill
  lining systems. It effectively seals hazardous waste, prevents toxic leachate from contaminating
  surrounding soil and groundwater, and provides reliable cap closure solutions for long-term
  municipal waste isolation.][91]
  
  Jul. 24, 2026
* [ [EcoGeoX Geomembrane | Offer Complete Containment Liner Solutions] ][92]
  
  [EcoGeoX Geomembrane | Offer Complete Containment Liner Solutions][93]
  
  [EcoGeoX Geomembrane is widely used in water containment, landfill lining, mining tailings
  storage, aquaculture ponds, wastewater treatment, reservoirs, canals, irrigation systems, oil &
  gas containment, biogas plants and environmental protection projects. It provides excellent
  impermeability, chemical resistance, UV stability and long-term durability for global engineering
  applications.][94]
  
  Jul. 23, 2026

[Our Partner][95]

[Application][96]

* [Advanced EcoGeoX Concrete Liners with Top Integrated Anchor Studs][98]
* [Industrial Concrete Protective Liners (CPL) --- EcoGeoX Solutions][99]

[FAQ][100]

  Both. Our manufacturer/factory is located in Shando

[FAQ][100]
* Are you a factory or trading company? Where is your company located?
  
  Both. Our manufacturer/factory is located in Shandong, China. Also we have two trading companies
  in Hong Kong and Qingdao respectively, in order to offer more professional service to our clients
  friends.
* What kind of testing do you have for products?
  
  We have ISO, CMA, CE.
* How do you ensure the quality?
  
  We are working with three QC processes to guarantee the quality: 1. For raw materials; 2. Onsite
  inspection during production; 3. Final QC test for each batch of finished products. Meantime, we
  have our own laboratory with the whole and complete procedures for quality guarantee.
* What is your productivity?
  
  Normally about 2 to 3 days as the production period for one 20GP or 40HQ of Geomembrane and
  Geotextile, GCL etc. Others within one week.

### Ferguson Waterworks uses VODA.ai® LeadZero™ to save a customer $7M in expenditures.

][83]

The City of Rock Hill is the 5th most populous city in South Carolina with 75,000 utility residents.
After the Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR) and EPA mandates, the municipality had to conduct
over 30,000 field visits, totaling nearly $7.5 million. Ferguson Waterworks reduced required lead
pipe field inspections by 97% using VODA.ai LeadZero technology—saving the City of Rock Hill $7M.

[Geosynthetics & Stormwater][65], [Utility Infrastructure][66], and MRO products. Furthermore, we
support customers from project inception to ongoing maintenance with regional experts, innovative
[solutions][67], dedicated project management, and more. Backed by local service and nationwide
distribution, we partner with you to ensure on-time delivery, successful outcomes, and secure
budgets. [Find your local expert][68].

### Who does Ferguson Waterworks work with?

We serve engineers, city planners, landscape architects, heavy highway contractors, underground
utility contractors, and public works/line contractors throughout the nation, delivering safe,
compliant, and sustainable [products][69] for municipal, utility (including public, private,
investor-owned, and hybrid segments), [NPS][70], [DOT][71], and other agencies. [Contact your local
Ferguson Waterworks expert][72] or [send us a message for project assistance][73].

### Why choose Ferguson Waterworks?

Our [nationwide footprint][74], [local experts][75], and reliable supply chain ensure on-time,
cost-effective project delivery. Not to mention, our comprehensive inventory and start-to-finish
support eliminate the need for multiple supply vendors. As a result, we simplify procurement, reduce
roadblocks, and lower total costs. We provide regulatory compliance guidance to uphold [EPA][76] and
state water quality standards and maintain active memberships in [AWWA][77], [WEF][78], [NUCA][79],
and [NRWA][80]. [Learn more about us.][81]

### Where can I find a Ferguson Waterworks branch?

With 270+ branches strategically placed across the U.S., Ferguson Waterworks provides local
expertise and access to critical products wherever projects happen. [Find your nearest Ferguson
Waterworks location.][82]

### Featured Case Study

### Ferguson Waterworks uses VODA.ai® LeadZero™ to save a customer $7M in expenditures.

][83]

The City of Rock Hill is the 5th most populous city in South Carolina with 75,000 utility residents.
After the Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR) and EPA mandates, the municipality had to conduct
over 30,000 field visits, totaling nearly $7.5 million. Ferguson Waterworks reduced required lead
pipe field inspections by 97% using VODA.ai LeadZero technology—saving the City of Rock Hill $7M.

# Winning **Together**

At Fibertex Nonwovens, we pioneer and innovate the way industries work with nonwovens and
performance materials. We enable our customers to create high-performance and sustainable solutions,
that improve the quality of life for people.

## Business Areas

### Acoustics

Unique sound absorption. We offer you freedomto design with optimal acoustic solutions.

[Read more][252]

### Automotive

We enable our customers to develop and improve automotive parts – excelling in superior lightweight,
high-performing nonwovens solutions.

[Read more][253]

### Bedding

We work closely with our customers in the bedding industry to develop and improve products, using
high-performance nonwovens materials.

[Read more][254]

### BUILDING INDUSTRY

We work closely with our customers in the construction sector, to create dependable construction
solutions, using high-performance materials.

[Read more][255]

### CIVIL ENGiNEERING

The Fibertex geosynthetics range, which is engineered to deliver exceptional performance, provides
the optimal solution for every geotechnical problem.

[Read more][256]

### COMPOSITES

Fibertex’ solutions for composites are used to build some of the longest blades for wind turbines,
luxury boats, the fastest cars, trains, planes, and much more.

[Read more][257]

### Concrete

We have extensive experience in providing dependable solutions for strengthening the long-term
performance of concrete structures in aggressive environments.

[Read more][258]

### FILTRATION

The Fibertex team has been developing high-performance materials and filter media for over 50 years,
to develop advanced filtration products. 

[Read more][259]

### FLOORING

Fibertex has been creating excellent flooring solutions, to meet exact customer requirements, since
our establishment in 1968.

[Read more][260]

### FOOTWEAR

Fibertex has established a leading position in the global footwear market, with a commitment to fine
design and the highest quality manufacturing standards

[Read more][261]

### FURNITURE

Fibertex offers versatile solutions for backings, barriers and reinforcement materials needed to
build exceptional furniture.

[Read more][262]

### Home and garden

Long lasting solutions with minimal maintenance enable you to relax instead of working hard in your
garden.

[Read more][263]

### MEDICO

Fibertex offers a wide range of fabrics, developed especially for use in wound-care and dressings.

[Read more][264]

### WIPES

If your needs go beyond standardised wipes, allow us to work with you to develop products for your
specific requirements.

[Read more][265]

### Special Solutions

Fibertex is committed to developing innovative solutions to meet constantly changing trends.

# Winning **Together**

At Fibertex Nonwovens, we pioneer and innovate the way industries work with nonwovens and
performance materials. We enable our customers to create high-performance and sustainable solutions,
that improve the quality of life for people.

## Business Areas

### Acoustics

Unique sound absorption. We offer you freedomto design with optimal acoustic solutions.

[Read more][252]

### Automotive

We enable our customers to develop and improve automotive parts – excelling in superior lightweight,
high-performing nonwovens solutions.

[Read more][253]

### Bedding

We work closely with our customers in the bedding industry to develop and improve products, using
high-performance nonwovens materials.

[Read more][254]

### BUILDING INDUSTRY

We work closely with our customers in the construction sector, to create dependable construction
solutions, using high-performance materials.

[Read more][255]

### CIVIL ENGiNEERING

The Fibertex geosynthetics range, which is engineered to deliver exceptional performance, provides
the optimal solution for every geotechnical problem.

[Read more][256]

### COMPOSITES

Fibertex’ solutions for composites are used to build some of the longest blades for wind turbines,
luxury boats, the fastest cars, trains, planes, and much more.

[Read more][257]

globally consistency with manufacturing standards and quality controls

as leading specialists in the global nonwovens industry

of certified durability

### Concrete

We have extensive experience in providing dependable solutions for strengthening the long-term
performance of concrete structures in aggressive environments.

[Read more][258]

### FILTRATION

The Fibertex team has been developing high-performance materials and filter media for over 50 years,
to develop advanced filtration products. 

[Read more][259]

### FLOORING

Fibertex has been creating excellent flooring solutions, to meet exact customer requirements, since
our establishment in 1968.

[Read more][260]

### FOOTWEAR

Fibertex has established a leading position in the global footwear market, with a commitment to fine
design and the highest quality manufacturing standards

[Read more][261]

### FURNITURE

Fibertex offers versatile solutions for backings, barriers and reinforcement materials needed to
build exceptional furniture.

[Read more][262]

### Home and garden

Long lasting solutions with minimal maintenance enable you to relax instead of working hard in your
garden.

[Read more][263]

### MEDICO

Fibertex offers a wide range of fabrics, developed especially for use in wound-care and dressings.

[Read more][264]

### WIPES

If your needs go beyond standardised wipes, allow us to work with you to develop products for your
specific requirements.

[Read more][265]

### Special Solutions

Fibertex is committed to developing innovative solutions to meet constantly changing trends.

[Read more][266]

### Looking for something else?

If you haven’t been able to find a product for your exact requirements, please contact us.

Fibertex is committed to developing innovative solutions to meet constantly changing global trends.
So, if there is a nonwovens or fine fibre solution our engineering team could develop specifically
for you, please allow us to do this. 

[Read more][267]

#### CLICK ON THE ICON TO EXPLORE THE SECTORS WE WORK IN

✕
[Roads-thumbnail]

### Road

Geofabrics geosynthetics are used in roads to ensure the best construction performance to both
minimise construction costs and prevent costly maintenance disruptions.

Geofabrics provide solutions that encompass all road types, from temporary access tracks to high
volume roads.

[More »][149]
✕
[Waste-containment-thumbnail]

### Waste Management

Geosynthetic engineering is the use of synthetic materials in waste and containment projects to
achieve more cost effective, safer and more environmentally sound outcomes.

The design techniques bring numerous benefits to waste and containment projects, because
geosynthetics can better protect the environment, through the control of hazardous leachates and
liquors.

[More »][150]
✕
[Mining-thumbnail]

### Mining & Resources

Geosynthetic engineering is the use of synthetic materials in civil engineering and mining projects
to achieve more cost effective, environmentally sound and safer construction outcomes.

The design techniques bring particular benefits to mine sites, because geosynthetics maximise the
use of site soils and avoid the need to import additional construction materials. 

[More »][151]
✕
[Slopes-walls-thumbnail]

### Slopes & Walls

Geofabrics offers a range of engineered slope, embankment and retaining wall solutions used to
construct infrastructure projects.

[More »][152]
✕
[Rail-thumbnail]

### Rail

The Geofabrics Rail Division has critical design expertise and a long project history in
the utilisation of geosynthetics for the construction and maintenance of rail formations.

We offer a range of solutions for new track construction as well as renewal or maintenance of
existing railway tracks which can deliver both construction savings and life-cycle optimisation.

[More »][153]
✕
[Water-thumbnail]

### Water

Geosynthetic engineering is the use of synthetic materials in water storage and treatment projects
to achieve more cost effective, environmentally sound and safer construction outcomes.

[More »][154]
✕
[Coastal-thumbnail]

### Coastal

Coastal erosion is a significant problem in Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific with rising sea
levels, extreme storms and climate change having a significant impact on shorelines.

Geofabrics coastal solutions are designed to reduce the effects of coastal and estuarine erosion
whilst maintaining safety and amenity for the community.

[More »][155]
✕
[Tunnel-thumbnail]

### Tunnels

Tunnel construction, maintenance and longevity depends on optimal drainage, waterproofing, sealing,
portals, erosion control and load support.

Geofabrics can provide engineering solutions and testing to reduce costs, while maintaining design
life.

[More »][156]
✕
[Defence-thumbnail]

### Defence

Geosynthetic engineering on defence projects is the use of synthetic materials to achieve more
cost-effective, environmentally sound and safer construction outcomes.

[More »][157]
✕
[Renewable-energy-thumbnail]

### Renewable Energy

We develop geosynthetic solutions for renewable energy infrastructure to reduce cost, environmental
impact and risk, and add value to each project.

[More »][158]
✕
[Port-aviation-thumbnail]

### Ports & Aviation

Geofabrics has a range of geosynthetic solutions for both landside and seaside components of port
infrastructure, including reinforcing hardstand areas, consolidation of soft soils and marine
breakwaters.

[More »][159]
✕
[Sport thumbnail]

### Sport & Recreation

Our aim is to provide product solutions that maximise playing hours on natural and synthetic sport
fields, racetracks and golf courses by creating excellent drainage, filtration and stabilisation
solutions to help maintain optimum field conditions while reducing construction and
maintenance costs for our customers.

[More »][160]
✕
[Civic-landscaping-thumbnail]

### Civic & Landscaping

Geofabrics offers a range of engineered slope, embankment and retaining wall solutions used to
construct civic and landscaping projects.

[More »][161]
✕
[Building-thumbnail]

### Building

Geofabrics offers a range of innovative geosynthetic solutions across the building sector, including
stormwater, structural, architectural and landscaping products.

[More »][162]
✕
[Primary-industry-thumbnail]

### Primary Industries

The use of geosynthetics in agricultural applications is growing, with increasing regulations
governing the containment and disposal of pesticides, fungicides and insecticides; the conservation
and protection of water; and the effects of climate change in the form of extreme weather events
like drought, heat-waves, and insect infestations.

[More »][163]

## PROTECTING THE WORLD FOR FUTURE GENERATIONS

Through engineering, science, and innovation, Geofabrics are solving big environmental and
infrastructure challenges using geosynthetics.

With our partners and customers we are protecting, containing and securing our world for tomorrow.

#### CLICK ON THE ICON TO EXPLORE THE SECTORS WE WORK IN

✕
[Roads-thumbnail]

### Road

Geofabrics geosynthetics are used in roads to ensure the best construction performance to both
minimise construction costs and prevent costly maintenance disruptions.

Geofabrics provide solutions that encompass all road types, from temporary access tracks to high
volume roads.

[More »][149]
✕
[Waste-containment-thumbnail]

### Waste Management

Geosynthetic engineering is the use of synthetic materials in waste and containment projects to
achieve more cost effective, safer and more environmentally sound outcomes.

The design techniques bring numerous benefits to waste and containment projects, because
geosynthetics can better protect the environment, through the control of hazardous leachates and
liquors.

[More »][150]
✕
[Mining-thumbnail]

### Mining & Resources

Geosynthetic engineering is the use of synthetic materials in civil engineering and mining projects
to achieve more cost effective, environmentally sound and safer construction outcomes.

The design techniques bring particular benefits to mine sites, because geosynthetics maximise the
use of site soils and avoid the need to import additional construction materials. 

[More »][151]
✕
[Slopes-walls-thumbnail]

### Slopes & Walls

Geofabrics offers a range of engineered slope, embankment and retaining wall solutions used to
construct infrastructure projects.

[More »][152]
✕
[Rail-thumbnail]

### Rail

The Geofabrics Rail Division has critical design expertise and a long project history in
the utilisation of geosynthetics for the construction and maintenance of rail formations.

We offer a range of solutions for new track construction as well as renewal or maintenance of
existing railway tracks which can deliver both construction savings and life-cycle optimisation.

[More »][153]
✕
[Water-thumbnail]

### Water

Geosynthetic engineering is the use of synthetic materials in water storage and treatment projects
to achieve more cost effective, environmentally sound and safer construction outcomes.

[More »][154]
✕
[Coastal-thumbnail]

### Coastal

Coastal erosion is a significant problem in Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific with rising sea
levels, extreme storms and climate change having a significant impact on shorelines.

Geofabrics coastal solutions are designed to reduce the effects of coastal and estuarine erosion
whilst maintaining safety and amenity for the community.

[More »][155]
✕
[Tunnel-thumbnail]

### Tunnels

Tunnel construction, maintenance and longevity depends on optimal drainage, waterproofing, sealing,
portals, erosion control and load support.

Geofabrics can provide engineering solutions and testing to reduce costs, while maintaining design
life.

[More »][156]
✕
[Defence-thumbnail]

### Defence

Geosynthetic engineering on defence projects is the use of synthetic materials to achieve more
cost-effective, environmentally sound and safer construction outcomes.

[More »][157]
✕
[Renewable-energy-thumbnail]

### Renewable Energy

We develop geosynthetic solutions for renewable energy infrastructure to reduce cost, environmental
impact and risk, and add value to each project.

[More »][158]
✕
[Port-aviation-thumbnail]

### Ports & Aviation

Geofabrics has a range of geosynthetic solutions for both landside and seaside components of port
infrastructure, including reinforcing hardstand areas, consolidation of soft soils and marine
breakwaters.

[More »][159]
✕
[Sport thumbnail]

### Sport & Recreation

Our aim is to provide product solutions that maximise playing hours on natural and synthetic sport
fields, racetracks and golf courses by creating excellent drainage, filtration and stabilisation
solutions to help maintain optimum field conditions while reducing construction and
maintenance costs for our customers.

[More »][160]
✕
[Civic-landscaping-thumbnail]

### Civic & Landscaping

Geofabrics offers a range of engineered slope, embankment and retaining wall solutions used to
construct civic and landscaping projects.

[More »][161]
✕
[Building-thumbnail]

### Building

Geofabrics offers a range of innovative geosynthetic solutions across the building sector, including
stormwater, structural, architectural and landscaping products.

[More »][162]
✕
[Primary-industry-thumbnail]

### Primary Industries

The use of geosynthetics in agricultural applications is growing, with increasing regulations
governing the containment and disposal of pesticides, fungicides and insecticides; the conservation
and protection of water; and the effects of climate change in the form of extreme weather events
like drought, heat-waves, and insect infestations.

[More »][163]

## PROTECTING THE WORLD FOR FUTURE GENERATIONS

Through engineering, science, and innovation, Geofabrics are solving big environmental and
infrastructure challenges using geosynthetics.

With our partners and customers we are protecting, containing and securing our world for tomorrow.

# We specialise in HDPE - LLDPE liners for Dam and Pond lining

We can **plan**, **manage**, and **build** multi-phase jobs.

[ Learn More ][48]

## Geosynthetic Supply & Installation

GeoNational is a **geosynthetics supply and installation contractor** that specialises in
engineering containment projects. Our headquarters are located in **Perth, Western Australia**, but
we provide services both **nationally** and **internationally**.

We pride ourselves on delivering personalised service to our clients and their representatives,
ensuring that all projects are engineered to the highest quality standards. Our goal is to provide
value for money and quality workmanship.

With our extensive experience and skills in the geosynthetics, civil construction, and environmental
containment sectors, we have forged long-standing partnerships and strategic alliances worldwide.

This allows us to source and test quality materials that meet even the most stringent criteria.

[ More about us ][49]

## Striving for Excellence in the Geosynthetic Industry

With over 20 years of experience, GeoNational was founded by a leading Geosynthetic Installer who
has a passion for safety and innovation, as well as a strong commitment to advancing the
geosynthetic industry. Our founder has gained valuable insight into the industry from the ground up
and has identified opportunities for improvement and evolution to better meet the needs of our
clients and benefit our employees’ lives in the future.

### For more information about our services and products, please contact us

[ Contact Us ][53]

## The GeoNational difference

#### Experience

Combined, our staff have over 20 years' experience in the geosynthetic lining industry.

#### Service

We pride ourselves on customer service, customer satisfaction and positive job outcomes.

#### Coverage

Geonational covers all local and international applications for geosynthetic products.

#### Pricing

We strive to give the best value for money whilst still maintaining high safety and quality
standard.

## What our clients say

Great company and so easy to deal with. Thanks for a great job at late notice.
Civil PM

## Our key services

 
* Geomembranes (HDPE / LLDPE / GCL / Geotextiles / Geocomposite supply & installation)
* Landfill lining systems
* Landfill capping systems
* Tailings Storage Facilities / Dams, heap leach pads and TSF lifts / raises
* Evaporation ponds
* Bio Retention basins and Bio Pile design and construct
* Water storages
* Turkey nest liners (supply and install)
* Geomembrane liner integrity inspections / assessments (including performance / integrity testing)
  and specialist repairs
* Electronic Leak Location Surveys (ELLS)

# We specialise in HDPE - LLDPE liners for Dam and Pond lining

We can **plan**, **manage**, and **build** multi-phase jobs.

[ Learn More ][48]

## Geosynthetic Supply & Installation

GeoNational is a **geosynthetics supply and installation contractor** that specialises in
engineering containment projects. Our headquarters are located in **Perth, Western Australia**, but
we provide services both **nationally** and **internationally**.

We pride ourselves on delivering personalised service to our clients and their representatives,
ensuring that all projects are engineered to the highest quality standards. Our goal is to provide
value for money and quality workmanship.

With our extensive experience and skills in the geosynthetics, civil construction, and environmental
containment sectors, we have forged long-standing partnerships and strategic alliances worldwide.

This allows us to source and test quality materials that meet even the most stringent criteria.

[ More about us ][49]
[

][51]

## Geosynthetic Products

][52]

## Striving for Excellence in the Geosynthetic Industry

With over 20 years of experience, GeoNational was founded by a leading Geosynthetic Installer who
has a passion for safety and innovation, as well as a strong commitment to advancing the
geosynthetic industry. Our founder has gained valuable insight into the industry from the ground up
and has identified opportunities for improvement and evolution to better meet the needs of our
clients and benefit our employees’ lives in the future.

### For more information about our services and products, please contact us

[ Contact Us ][53]

## The GeoNational difference

#### Experience

Combined, our staff have over 20 years' experience in the geosynthetic lining industry.

#### Service

We pride ourselves on customer service, customer satisfaction and positive job outcomes.

#### Coverage

Geonational covers all local and international applications for geosynthetic products.

#### Pricing

We strive to give the best value for money whilst still maintaining high safety and quality
standard.

## What our clients say

Great company and so easy to deal with. Thanks for a great job at late notice.
Civil PM

## Our key services

 
* Geomembranes (HDPE / LLDPE / GCL / Geotextiles / Geocomposite supply & installation)
* Landfill lining systems
* Landfill capping systems
* Tailings Storage Facilities / Dams, heap leach pads and TSF lifts / raises
* Evaporation ponds
* Bio Retention basins and Bio Pile design and construct
* Water storages
* Turkey nest liners (supply and install)
* Geomembrane liner integrity inspections / assessments (including performance / integrity testing)
  and specialist repairs
* Electronic Leak Location Surveys (ELLS)

International Geosynthetics Society

The home of geosynthetics

[ Become an IGS Member ][265]

Introducing IGS

We are a learned society dedicated to the advancement of geotextiles, geomembranes and their related
products and technologies.

We connect engineers, researchers, and industry professionals through knowledge, events, and global
collaboration.

[ Learn More ][266]
[ [NEW IGS Geosynthetics Handbook] ][267]
[ Order Now ][268]
[sustainability]

Sustainability

Geosynthetics make infrastructure more sustainable. They extend the service life of roads, reduce
the use of aggregates, conserve and protect water, minimize land disturbance and control soil
erosion.

[ Learn More ][269]

IGS Membership

Join the International Geosynthetics Society and connect with a global network of professionals. 

With membership options for individuals (including students), corporate organisations, and premium
partners, IGS offers access to resources, events, and opportunities to support the growth of
geosynthetics worldwide.

[ Individual ][270]
[ Corporate Member ][271]
[ Premium Corporate Member ][272]
[ Member Portal ][273]
[Colombia Ambassador event 2025.2]

Upcoming Events

Stay up to date with the latest IGS events, including conferences, webinars, and professional
development courses taking place around the world.

[ Explore Events ][274]

We are everywhere!

IGS membership is supported through local Chapters, which connect members within a specific country
or region. Chapters bring the global IGS community closer to home by organising local events,
webinars, networking opportunities, and professional development activities tailored to their area.

Joining a Chapter helps members connect with local engineers, researchers, academics, and industry
professionals while still benefiting from the international reach of the IGS. It’s a great way to
stay informed, build professional relationships, and support the advancement of geosynthetics
worldwide.

## Wang Deqi

##### (China)

Mr. Wang Deqi is the inventor of anti-UV weed mat in China, the  Deputy Director of the Innovation
Committee of the China Agricultural Plastics Society under the supervision of the Ministry of
Agriculture, and a member of the International Association of Geomaterials. Previously, Mr. Wang
served as the Workstation Director of the National Industrial Fabric Quality Supervision and
Inspection Center. Mr. Wang led his team to successfully upgrade the “anti-aging” geotextile to the
professional “anti exposure” stage, especially the weed mat (100-300g woven geotextile), with an
exposed service life of up to 10-15 years, the world’s highest level.

Today, I am applying to join the IGS Council in order to participate in academic exchanges,
technology promotion, and other related work, together with promoting the development and progress
of international geotextiles in the field of environmental protection, and fulfill the mission of
IGS.

## Huabei Liu

##### (China)

Dr. Huabei Liu is an engineering professor at Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST)
with 25 years of experience in geosynthetic applications. Prior to joining HUST, he was granted
tenure as an associate professor at the City University of New York in Dec. 2013. His research
focuses on the long-term and dynamic responses of GRS structures, which has been materialized as
more than 80 refereed journal papers, and has promoted the applications of GRS structures in
earthquake-active areas and advanced the use of locally-available fill materials for GRS
applications.

Dr. Liu has been an active member of IGS since 2009. Currently he is an IGS Council Member, the
Secretary for the Chinese Chapter, an executive board member of China Technological Association of
Geosynthetics, and a member of ISSMGE TC 218 “Reinforced fill materials”. He also serves on the
editorial boards of the Canadian Geotechnical Journal, Computers and Geotechnics, Earthquake
Engineering and Structural Dynamics, and Transportation Infrastructure Geotechnology.

Dr. Liu is looking forward to better serving the community. He is particularly interested in
educating younger generations on geosynthetics, and promoting GRS applications in extreme
environments.

## Wang Deqi

##### (China)

Mr. Wang Deqi is the inventor of anti-UV weed mat in China, the  Deputy Director of the Innovation
Committee of the China Agricultural Plastics Society under the supervision of the Ministry of
Agriculture, and a member of the International Association of Geomaterials. Previously, Mr. Wang
served as the Workstation Director of the National Industrial Fabric Quality Supervision and
Inspection Center. Mr. Wang led his team to successfully upgrade the “anti-aging” geotextile to the
professional “anti exposure” stage, especially the weed mat (100-300g woven geotextile), with an
exposed service life of up to 10-15 years, the world’s highest level.

Today, I am applying to join the IGS Council in order to participate in academic exchanges,
technology promotion, and other related work, together with promoting the development and progress
of international geotextiles in the field of environmental protection, and fulfill the mission of
IGS.

## Huabei Liu

##### (China)

Dr. Huabei Liu is an engineering professor at Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST)
with 25 years of experience in geosynthetic applications. Prior to joining HUST, he was granted
tenure as an associate professor at the City University of New York in Dec. 2013. His research
focuses on the long-term and dynamic responses of GRS structures, which has been materialized as
more than 80 refereed journal papers, and has promoted the applications of GRS structures in
earthquake-active areas and advanced the use of locally-available fill materials for GRS
applications.

Dr. Liu has been an active member of IGS since 2009. Currently he is an IGS Council Member, the
Secretary for the Chinese Chapter, an executive board member of China Technological Association of
Geosynthetics, and a member of ISSMGE TC 218 “Reinforced fill materials”. He also serves on the
editorial boards of the Canadian Geotechnical Journal, Computers and Geotechnics, Earthquake
Engineering and Structural Dynamics, and Transportation Infrastructure Geotechnology.

Dr. Liu is looking forward to better serving the community. He is particularly interested in
educating younger generations on geosynthetics, and promoting GRS applications in extreme
environments.

## How do we do it?

[devider]

**Collaboration with Manufacturers and Developers – R & D, Product Development, Brand /Portfolio
Building, Operations, and Marketing Management, Representation **

HYDROEX™ aims to achieve global market access through a broad, diverse product range by forming
strategic alliances with reputable manufacturers and developers. These partnerships foster the
creation of innovative and sustainable ideas and products. All our services, from product & market
insight to strategy development to engineering & technical design, compliance, and further
Implementation & Execution, are supported by HYDROEX™, ensuring brands create market connections and
effectively expand their product-market sustainability portfolio. As a strategic partner throughout
your brand lifecycle. HYDROEX™ can support your entire brand-building, operation & execution process
or assist at specific stages, wherever clients' needs are greatest.

## Our Ideas and Implementation to Inspire…

## Water Management Systems using Polypropylene Geocellular
## System through RWHS and SuDS principles.

In partnership with Vikas Industries, India, HYDROEX™ developed and provides HD Polypropylene
Geocellular Systems that meet CIRIA guidelines and other international standards. These systems
support sustainable surface water and stormwater management through the SuDS approach, addressing
flood control, infiltration, attenuation, drought mitigation, and rainwater harvesting (RWHS). Our
solutions are trusted across various sectors, including ports, public infrastructure, municipal
projects, parking facilities, hospitals, parks, stadiums, military bases, large housing
developments, townships, flood control schemes, and catchment areas. With over a decade and a half
of product experience and installation success, backed by independent third-party lab tests, the HD
PP Geocellular Systems have proven reliable performance in diverse geographic and environmental
conditions, consistently meeting design requirements. With more than 250 major installations and
growth, our technology is widely recognized as an effective solution for water scarcity, flood
management, and sustainable water conservation.

## Sustainable & Durable Special Concrete Protection
## Technology by Xypex Crystallization Technology

HYDROEX™ partners with Xypex Chemical Corporation, Canada, to deliver globally trusted crystalline
concrete protection technology—an innovation with over five decades of proven performance.
Engineered to permanently integrate into the concrete matrix, the Xypex crystalline system enhances
waterproofing, chemical resistance, durability, and long-term structural integrity. Its exceptional
performance has made it a preferred solution across a wide range of critical structures, including
residential buildings, housing developments, underground vaults, nuclear facilities, marine
structures, water reservoirs, dams, bridges, tunnels, and canals, as well as large-scale
infrastructure projects worldwide. Xypex Technology is especially valuable in aggressive and
high-exposure environments such as potable water reservoirs, seawater intake systems, quay walls,
caissons, shipyards, chemical and power plants, deep foundations, and other capital-intensive
infrastructure. It protects structures from within, eliminating the need for external membranes and
significantly reducing maintenance cycles. This approach improves the lifecycle performance of
concrete assets, strengthening them against environmental stresses while supporting the
sustainability goals of modern infrastructure development. In MENA region, more than 300 signature
projects have been successfully handed over. First Nuclear Plant in the Middle East, Abu Dhabi, the
1st Metro Railway project in Dubai, then Doha Metro, Dry Dock in Ras Laffan, New Qatar Port Project,
IWPP in Qatar Ras Laffan, IWPP in Sur Oman, MIRFA in UAE, Desalination Plant in KSA. AQUA Park in
Kuwait, Ferrari Concept in Abu Dhabi, Kuwait Oil Company – Oil Sludge Tanks, Astana Mall & Hotel
Project in Kazakhstan, more…

## Municipal Casting for Infrastructure in collaboration with
## BSI Kitemark products from international foundries.

For over a decade, HYDROEX™ has been a reliable provider of Municipal Casting, Pipe Fittings, and
accessories solutions for major infrastructure projects throughout the MENA region and the USA. Our
range includes ductile and cast-iron covers and frames, pipe fittings, surface boxes, gully
gratings, channel gratings, multi-span covers & frames, specialized covers for ports, airports,
highways, and more, along with accessories designed for durability and heavy-duty use. These
products are made in partnership with top Indian foundries and adhere strictly to international
standards, such as BSI, ASTM, DIN, etc., and BSI Kitemark benchmarks. Their successful application
in numerous national and international projects—supported by approvals from key consultants and
authorities—demonstrates their proven quality, load capacity, and long-term reliability. HYDROEX™
municipal casting solutions and pipe fittings have become essential components of infrastructure
networks that require consistency, resilience, and compliance, reflecting our dedication to
providing dependable engineered products for expanding urban systems.

## Naue GmbH – Innovative Geosynthetics and Engineering
## Solutions for Modern Construction

NAUE GMbH – Germany is a globally recognized partner for geosynthetics and engineering solutions,
and has partnered with HYDROEX™ on major projects in Qatar and Kuwait. BBG, an Engineering wing of
NAUE, assisted HYDROEX™ in re-engineering the structural requirements of the projects to ensure
proper utilization and soil consolidation & load-bearing. As a German manufacturer and engineers
with decades of experience, they offer proven products and systems for construction, environmental
protection, infrastructure development, coastal protection, and energy projects. Our comprehensive
portfolio includes geogrids, geotextiles, geomembranes, drainage systems, erosion control, and
sealing solutions – developed to meet the highest technical and environmental standards.

Naue GmbH is a leading global manufacturer of geosynthetics, specializing in the development,
production, and application of high-quality solutions for geotechnical challenges. With decades of
experience, Naue offers a comprehensive range of products, including geosynthetic clay liners,
geogrids, geomembranes, geotextiles, and drainage mats. These products are utilized across various
sectors such as civil engineering

Wahidullah Halimi. Starting its activities from its main office in Doha, it has consistently grown

offices in Jordan, Turkey, Spain, Germany and Canada.

**Shirley Consulting Engineers** (SCE) is a Sydney-based investigative, remedial and ground
engineering practice that offers consulting services across Australia & Internationally. The firm
was set up in 1974, and specializes in the forensic evaluation of failures in civil & mining
engineering structures; the firm has also developed a deep understanding of the causes of slope &
ground instability and subsidence.

[ Read more ][28]
[images (1)]

**BBG Bauberatung Geokunststoffe GmbH & Co. KG** is a specialized geotechnical engineering
consultancy based in Germany. The company provides expert support for the design and application of
geosynthetics in various construction projects. The company specializes in engineering solutions
that utilize geosynthetic materials for soil reinforcement, drainage, and sealing. Their core
competencies include geotechnical design, application of geosynthetics, consulting and training,
construction projects.

**Nafees Khalfay Structural Consultant** is a Mumbai-based firm established in May 2007. With over
25 years of experience in structural engineering, Khalfay specializes in both traditional Reinforced
Cement Concrete (RCC), Ground Structural Engineering analysis, and Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB).

[ Read more ][30]
