## How do we do it?

[devider]

**Collaboration with Manufacturers and Developers – R & D, Product Development, Brand /Portfolio
Building, Operations, and Marketing Management, Representation **

HYDROEX™ aims to achieve global market access through a broad, diverse product range by forming
strategic alliances with reputable manufacturers and developers. These partnerships foster the
creation of innovative and sustainable ideas and products. All our services, from product & market
insight to strategy development to engineering & technical design, compliance, and further
Implementation & Execution, are supported by HYDROEX™, ensuring brands create market connections and
effectively expand their product-market sustainability portfolio. As a strategic partner throughout
your brand lifecycle. HYDROEX™ can support your entire brand-building, operation & execution process
or assist at specific stages, wherever clients' needs are greatest.

## Our Ideas and Implementation to Inspire…

## Water Management Systems using Polypropylene Geocellular
## System through RWHS and SuDS principles.

In partnership with Vikas Industries, India, HYDROEX™ developed and provides HD Polypropylene
Geocellular Systems that meet CIRIA guidelines and other international standards. These systems
support sustainable surface water and stormwater management through the SuDS approach, addressing
flood control, infiltration, attenuation, drought mitigation, and rainwater harvesting (RWHS). Our
solutions are trusted across various sectors, including ports, public infrastructure, municipal
projects, parking facilities, hospitals, parks, stadiums, military bases, large housing
developments, townships, flood control schemes, and catchment areas. With over a decade and a half
of product experience and installation success, backed by independent third-party lab tests, the HD
PP Geocellular Systems have proven reliable performance in diverse geographic and environmental
conditions, consistently meeting design requirements. With more than 250 major installations and
growth, our technology is widely recognized as an effective solution for water scarcity, flood
management, and sustainable water conservation.

## Sustainable & Durable Special Concrete Protection
## Technology by Xypex Crystallization Technology

HYDROEX™ partners with Xypex Chemical Corporation, Canada, to deliver globally trusted crystalline
concrete protection technology—an innovation with over five decades of proven performance.
Engineered to permanently integrate into the concrete matrix, the Xypex crystalline system enhances
waterproofing, chemical resistance, durability, and long-term structural integrity. Its exceptional
performance has made it a preferred solution across a wide range of critical structures, including
residential buildings, housing developments, underground vaults, nuclear facilities, marine
structures, water reservoirs, dams, bridges, tunnels, and canals, as well as large-scale
infrastructure projects worldwide. Xypex Technology is especially valuable in aggressive and
high-exposure environments such as potable water reservoirs, seawater intake systems, quay walls,
caissons, shipyards, chemical and power plants, deep foundations, and other capital-intensive
infrastructure. It protects structures from within, eliminating the need for external membranes and
significantly reducing maintenance cycles. This approach improves the lifecycle performance of
concrete assets, strengthening them against environmental stresses while supporting the
sustainability goals of modern infrastructure development. In MENA region, more than 300 signature
projects have been successfully handed over. First Nuclear Plant in the Middle East, Abu Dhabi, the
1st Metro Railway project in Dubai, then Doha Metro, Dry Dock in Ras Laffan, New Qatar Port Project,
IWPP in Qatar Ras Laffan, IWPP in Sur Oman, MIRFA in UAE, Desalination Plant in KSA. AQUA Park in
Kuwait, Ferrari Concept in Abu Dhabi, Kuwait Oil Company – Oil Sludge Tanks, Astana Mall & Hotel
Project in Kazakhstan, more…

## Municipal Casting for Infrastructure in collaboration with
## BSI Kitemark products from international foundries.

For over a decade, HYDROEX™ has been a reliable provider of Municipal Casting, Pipe Fittings, and
accessories solutions for major infrastructure projects throughout the MENA region and the USA. Our
range includes ductile and cast-iron covers and frames, pipe fittings, surface boxes, gully
gratings, channel gratings, multi-span covers & frames, specialized covers for ports, airports,
highways, and more, along with accessories designed for durability and heavy-duty use. These
products are made in partnership with top Indian foundries and adhere strictly to international
standards, such as BSI, ASTM, DIN, etc., and BSI Kitemark benchmarks. Their successful application
in numerous national and international projects—supported by approvals from key consultants and
authorities—demonstrates their proven quality, load capacity, and long-term reliability. HYDROEX™
municipal casting solutions and pipe fittings have become essential components of infrastructure
networks that require consistency, resilience, and compliance, reflecting our dedication to
providing dependable engineered products for expanding urban systems.

## Naue GmbH – Innovative Geosynthetics and Engineering
## Solutions for Modern Construction

NAUE GMbH – Germany is a globally recognized partner for geosynthetics and engineering solutions,
and has partnered with HYDROEX™ on major projects in Qatar and Kuwait. BBG, an Engineering wing of
NAUE, assisted HYDROEX™ in re-engineering the structural requirements of the projects to ensure
proper utilization and soil consolidation & load-bearing. As a German manufacturer and engineers
with decades of experience, they offer proven products and systems for construction, environmental
protection, infrastructure development, coastal protection, and energy projects. Our comprehensive
portfolio includes geogrids, geotextiles, geomembranes, drainage systems, erosion control, and
sealing solutions – developed to meet the highest technical and environmental standards.

Naue GmbH is a leading global manufacturer of geosynthetics, specializing in the development,

# International Association
# of Geosynthetics Installers

### Professional Installers. Professional Installations.

IAGI's mission is to advance installation and construction technologies as well as to provide a
central clearinghouse for comprehensive industry information. We invite you to join the
International Association of Geosynthetic Installers, a dynamic association of geosynthetic
professionals created by and for installers.

### *Missed our webinars? *

[You can view them under the resources & publications page.][122]

### Certified Welding Technician (CWT)

IAGI’s Certified Welding Technician (CWT) program recognizes the knowledge, experience and skill of
those technicians who hold the certification. 

Engineers benefit from IAGI's CWT program because certification verifies that the welders on their
job have experience in geomembrane welding and meet industry standards of skill for those
geomembranes they are certified in. IAGI encourages all engineers to require that any welding done
on their jobsite be done with CWTs.

[ Learn more about CWT ][123]

### Approved Installation Contractor (AIC)

IAGI’s Approved Installation Contractor recognizes geosynthetic installation companies that meet a
minimum level of professionalism, ethics and business practices. Approved Installation Contractors

verification, safety training, and professional competence and experience. Click on the links below

[ Learn more about AIC ][124]

### **GEO**GAMES

The International Association of Geosynthetics Installers (IAGI) is thrilled to announce that the
**4th GeoGames competition** will take place at the 13th International Conference on Geosynthetics
(ICG)!

Mark your calendars: **14 September 2026** in beautiful **Montréal, Québec, Canada**.

IAGI is offering sponsorships to fund this event. There are several options available to support the
**Geo**Games.  You can sign up by calling Laurie Honnigford at +1 (720) 353-4977 or by email at
i[agi@iagi.org][125].

[ Learn more about GeoGames ][126]

### IAGI Member Project Profiles

IAGI members set the standard for installation excellence -- and we're excited to showcase their
achievements! Want to see your project here next? Contact [Brian Fraser][127] and [Evan Bao][128] to
be featured. We will feature a new project each month.

This *Project Profile* features **GE Environmental, **who is proud to highlight the successful
completion of a major cooling pond installation project for a leading global mining company in
Saskatchewan, Canada. The project demonstrates the company's expertise in geosynthetics
installation, environmental containment systems, and innovative construction practices under
challenging site conditions.

[ Member Project Profiles ][129]

### InfoHub

**Geomembrane CQC Versus CQA**

The terms Construction Quality Control (CQC) and Construction Quality Assurance (CQA) are sometimes
used interchangeably in the geosynthetics industry, causing confusion about responsibilities and
program intent. This article clarifies the differences and the responsible parties for each element
of these important processes.

[ Full Article ][130]

central clearinghouse for comprehensive industry information. We invite you to join the
International Association of Geosynthetic Installers, a dynamic association of geosynthetic
professionals created by and for installers.

### *Missed our webinars? *

[You can view them under the resources & publications page.][122]

### Certified Welding Technician (CWT)

IAGI’s Certified Welding Technician (CWT) program recognizes the knowledge, experience and skill of
those technicians who hold the certification. 

Engineers benefit from IAGI's CWT program because certification verifies that the welders on their
job have experience in geomembrane welding and meet industry standards of skill for those
geomembranes they are certified in. IAGI encourages all engineers to require that any welding done
on their jobsite be done with CWTs.

[ Learn more about CWT ][123]

[ Learn more about AIC ][124]

### **GEO**GAMES

The International Association of Geosynthetics Installers (IAGI) is thrilled to announce that the
**4th GeoGames competition** will take place at the 13th International Conference on Geosynthetics
(ICG)!

Mark your calendars: **14 September 2026** in beautiful **Montréal, Québec, Canada**.

IAGI is offering sponsorships to fund this event. There are several options available to support the
**Geo**Games.  You can sign up by calling Laurie Honnigford at +1 (720) 353-4977 or by email at
i[agi@iagi.org][125].

[ Learn more about GeoGames ][126]

### IAGI Member Project Profiles

IAGI members set the standard for installation excellence -- and we're excited to showcase their
achievements! Want to see your project here next? Contact [Brian Fraser][127] and [Evan Bao][128] to
be featured. We will feature a new project each month.

This *Project Profile* features **GE Environmental, **who is proud to highlight the successful
completion of a major cooling pond installation project for a leading global mining company in
Saskatchewan, Canada. The project demonstrates the company's expertise in geosynthetics
installation, environmental containment systems, and innovative construction practices under
challenging site conditions.

[ Member Project Profiles ][129]

### InfoHub

**Geomembrane CQC Versus CQA**

The terms Construction Quality Control (CQC) and Construction Quality Assurance (CQA) are sometimes
used interchangeably in the geosynthetics industry, causing confusion about responsibilities and
program intent. This article clarifies the differences and the responsible parties for each element
of these important processes.

## Kaliteli Üretim ve Uzman Çalışanlar ile Projeleriniz için #DoğruÜrünDoğruÇözüm


İstanbul Teknik İnşaat, 1998 yılında %100 Türk sermayesiyle kurulan; yapı malzemesi üretimi, satışı,
mühendislik çözümleri ve uygulamaları alanında faaliyet gösteren öncü üretici firmalarındandır.
Türkiye’nin ilk ve en büyük geogrid üreticisi olan İstanbul Teknik, aynı zamanda International
Geosynthetics Society (IGS) üyesidir.

İstanbul Teknik, geniş ürün yelpazesi ile Geosentetik, Yeşil Çatı ve Çevre Düzenlemesi, Su ve Isı
Yalıtımı, Asfalt Yol Yapımı ve Bakımı, GeoArme Duvar, Mermer Tamiri ve Güçlendirme alanlarında
hizmet vermektedir. Uzman mühendis ve çalışanları ile her müşterisi için özgün çözümler sunar.
Geliştirdiği ürün, çözüm ve uygulamalarla birçok İLK ve EN İYİ'ye imza atmıştır.

## Kaliteli Üretim ve Uzman Çalışanlar ile Projeleriniz için #DoğruÜrünDoğruÇözüm


İstanbul Teknik İnşaat, 1998 yılında %100 Türk sermayesiyle kurulan; yapı malzemesi üretimi, satışı,
mühendislik çözümleri ve uygulamaları alanında faaliyet gösteren öncü üretici firmalarındandır.
Türkiye’nin ilk ve en büyük geogrid üreticisi olan İstanbul Teknik, aynı zamanda International
Geosynthetics Society (IGS) üyesidir.

İstanbul Teknik, geniş ürün yelpazesi ile Geosentetik, Yeşil Çatı ve Çevre Düzenlemesi, Su ve Isı
Yalıtımı, Asfalt Yol Yapımı ve Bakımı, GeoArme Duvar, Mermer Tamiri ve Güçlendirme alanlarında
hizmet vermektedir. Uzman mühendis ve çalışanları ile her müşterisi için özgün çözümler sunar.
Geliştirdiği ürün, çözüm ve uygulamalarla birçok İLK ve EN İYİ'ye imza atmıştır.

İstanbul Teknik, geniş ürün yelpazesi ile Geosentetik, Yeşil Çatı ve Çevre Düzenlemesi, Su ve Isı
Yalıtımı, Asfalt Yol Yapımı ve Bakımı, GeoArme Duvar, Mermer Tamiri ve Güçlendirme alanlarında
hizmet vermektedir. Uzman mühendis ve çalışanları ile her müşterisi için özgün çözümler sunar.
Geliştirdiği ürün, çözüm ve uygulamalarla birçok İLK ve EN İYİ'ye imza atmıştır.

Komitex Group is one of the largest manufacturers of nonwoven materials in Russia.

**Komitex GEO** (part of Komitex Group) is a leader in production and sales of geosynthetic
materials in Russia and CIS. On international markets Komitex GEO can offer its’ customers high
level of service, wide range of goods and reasonable level of prices. Every year Komitex Group
produces over 100 million m² or 30 000 tons of nonwoven materials on its factory in Syktyvkar.

Naue is a globally recognized partner for [geosynthetics][173] and engineering solutions. As a
German manufacturer with decades of experience, we offer proven [products][174] and systems for
construction, environmental protection, infrastructure development, coastal protection, and energy
projects. Our comprehensive portfolio includes **[geogrids][175], [geotextiles][176],
[geomembranes][177], drainage systems, [erosion control][178], and sealing solutions** – developed
to meet the highest technical and environmental standards.

### Mining

The mining industry relies on geosynthetics to enhance environmental protection, operational
efficiency, and infrastructure durability. These materials play a vital role in heap leach pads,
tailings storage facilities, and mine site containment solutions. ✔ Tailings Containment &
Environmental Protection Mining operations generate large volumes of tailings, requiring secure
containment solutions to prevent contamination. Geomembranes, geotextiles, and geosynthetic clay
liners (GCLs) provide an impermeable barrier that protects groundwater and reduces environmental
risks. ✔ Heap Leach Pads & Drainage Systems Geosynthetics are essential in the construction of heap
leach pads, ensuring efficient leaching processes while minimizing liner failure risks. Drainage
geocomposites improve liquid flow, maximizing metal recovery and site efficiency. ✔ Erosion Control
& Soil Stabilization Mining infrastructure, such as haul roads, stockpiles, and embankments,
requires erosion-resistant solutions to withstand heavy loads and harsh environments. Geogrids,
geotextiles, and erosion control blankets reinforce soil structure and improve long-term stability.
✔ Durability in Harsh Conditions Geosynthetics are engineered to withstand extreme weather
conditions, chemical exposure, and heavy loads, making them ideal for remote and high-stress mining
environments. Why Choose Penteco for Mining Geosynthetics? The Penteco team has extensive experience
providing geosynthetic solutions for mining operations across Canada, including Alberta, British
Columbia, and remote mining sites. 🔹 Tailored Engineering Solutions – We design and supply custom
geosynthetic systems to meet the unique demands of each mining project. 🔹 High-Quality Materials –
We source premium geomembranes, geotextiles, and GCLs to ensure maximum performance. 🔹 Expert
Installation & Support – Our team provides full-service installation, quality assurance, and field

about us

Qingdao Looking Forward

New Material Technology Co., Ltd

Our company is a Chinese company that provides anti-seepage solutions, products, and services for
geosynthetics. Its main application areas include the landfill, storage, and management of solid,
liquid, and gaseous hazardous waste in mining, petrochemicals, reservoirs, roads, tunnels, and
aquaculture. The company's S team was established in 2002; The International Trading Company was
established in 2026. For 24 years, we have been committed to producing and developing innovative
geosynthetic anti-seepage products. The main products of the company are geotextile, geomembrane,
geogrid, geocell, geotube, geotextile composite drainage network, geotextile composite clay lining
and other geotextile products.

Municipal Solid Waste Landfill

Modern sanitary landfills demand multi-barrier containment systems that protect groundwater and soil
from leachate contamination over a design life of 100 years or more.

Mining Tailings Pond

Mining Tailings Pond & Heap Leach Pad Liner System

Mining operations generate vast quantities of tailings and process solutions that must be contained
to prevent acid mine drainage, heavy metal leaching, and cyanide contamination of the surrounding
environment.

Highway & Railway

Highway & Railway Embankment on Soft Ground

A multi-geosynthetics solution combining high-strength woven geotextile, biaxial geogrid, nonwoven
geotextile separator, and geocell to stabilize soft subgrades, control settlement, and extend
pavement life.

Reservoir, Dam & Irrigation Canal

Reservoir, Dam & Irrigation Canal Waterproofing System

A comprehensive geosynthetics-based solution combining HDPE geomembrane, GCL, geotextile, and
geocomposite drainage layers to achieve zero-leakage environmental protection.

Slope Protection

Slope Protection, Erosion Control & Mechanically Stabilized Retaining Walls

An integrated geosynthetics solution combining uniaxial geogrid, geocell, nonwoven geotextile, and
erosion control blanket to stabilize slopes, prevent erosion, and construct cost-effective
reinforced earth retaining walls.

about us

Qingdao Looking Forward

New Material Technology Co., Ltd

Our company is a Chinese company that provides anti-seepage solutions, products, and services for
geosynthetics. Its main application areas include the landfill, storage, and management of solid,
liquid, and gaseous hazardous waste in mining, petrochemicals, reservoirs, roads, tunnels, and
aquaculture. The company's S team was established in 2002; The International Trading Company was
established in 2026. For 24 years, we have been committed to producing and developing innovative
geosynthetic anti-seepage products. The main products of the company are geotextile, geomembrane,
geogrid, geocell, geotube, geotextile composite drainage network, geotextile composite clay lining
and other geotextile products.

Waste Landfill

Municipal Solid Waste Landfill

Modern sanitary landfills demand multi-barrier containment systems that protect groundwater and soil
from leachate contamination over a design life of 100 years or more.

Mining Tailings Pond

Mining Tailings Pond & Heap Leach Pad Liner System

Mining operations generate vast quantities of tailings and process solutions that must be contained
to prevent acid mine drainage, heavy metal leaching, and cyanide contamination of the surrounding
environment.

Highway & Railway

Highway & Railway Embankment on Soft Ground

A multi-geosynthetics solution combining high-strength woven geotextile, biaxial geogrid, nonwoven
geotextile separator, and geocell to stabilize soft subgrades, control settlement, and extend
pavement life.

Reservoir, Dam & Irrigation Canal

Reservoir, Dam & Irrigation Canal Waterproofing System

A comprehensive geosynthetics-based solution combining HDPE geomembrane, GCL, geotextile, and
geocomposite drainage layers to achieve zero-leakage environmental protection.

Slope Protection

Slope Protection, Erosion Control & Mechanically Stabilized Retaining Walls

An integrated geosynthetics solution combining uniaxial geogrid, geocell, nonwoven geotextile, and
erosion control blanket to stabilize slopes, prevent erosion, and construct cost-effective
reinforced earth retaining walls.

Product application

Landfill, storage, and management of solid, liquid, and gaseous hazardous waste in mining,

**SKAPS Industries** is a leading manufacturer and supplier of various extrusion-based geosynthetic
products & technical textiles. We have a strong market presence in over 60 countries, offering our
clients a wide array of products. Whether it’s Geosynthetics, Fiberglass Fabrics, or Structural Core

NW & Woven Geotextiles ideal for industrial & agricultural applications

#### 01.

[

### Geosynthetics

][63]

*Geosynthetics* are synthetic products used to stabilize terrain. They are generally polymeric
products used to solve civil engineering problems.

#### 02.

[

### Fiberglass Fabrics

][64]

Cheaper and more flexible than carbon fiber, it is stronger than many metals by weight,
non-magnetic, non-conductive, transparent to electromagnetic radiation.

#### 03.

### Structural Core Material

Composite core materials are customized to complete the function of engineered structures.

#### 04.

### civil applications

Skaps Geosynthetics are used as drains and filters in civil and environmental activities in addition
to replacement of conventional materials.

#### 05.

[

### environmental applications

][65]

Skaps Geosynthetics are used in a variety of situations including pipeline construction, water
filtration, prevention of soil erosion, and protection. 

#### 06.

[

### industrial applications

][66]

These applications include roads, airfields, railroads, embankments, retaining structures,
reservoirs, canals, dams, and more.

## aboutus

Mount Taishan Industrial Development Group Co., Ltd. is located at the foot of the world-famous
Mount Taishan Mountain. The Group has four wholly-owned subsidiaries, Hengze New Materials Group
Co., Ltd., Hongxiang Medical Co., Ltd., Risso Chemical Co., Ltd., and Shandong Hongji New Materials
Co., Ltd. The group company mainly produces four major categories of products: geotechnical
materials, medical equipment, chemical products, and steel products.

The group company has a complete and scientific quality management system, and its products have
passed ISO9000 and IS013485 international quality system certification. The group company can not
only produce products that meet national standards, but also produce products that meet foreign

**Hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực sản xuất sản phẩm địa kỹ thuật tại Việt Nam**

[ Yêu cầu báo giá ][38]

### ****VỀ CHÚNG TÔI****

*Công ty TNHH XNK Thái Châu được thành lập vào ngày 25 tháng 06 năm 2005. Với hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm
trong lĩnh vực sản xuất sản phẩm địa kỹ thuật cho các công trình xây dựng như: vải địa kỹ thuật, bấc
thấm, màng GCL, Geotube, Geocell, màng chống thấm HDPE, lưới địa kỹ thuật… Chúng tôi không ngừng
nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ, mang đến những giá trị tốt nhất cho Quý khách hàng.*

Hiện Thái Châu là nhà sản xuất các sản phẩm địa kỹ thuật hàng đầu tại  Việt Nam.
Với sự phát triển không ngừng, vào cuối năm 2015 chúng tôi đã thành lập Nhà máy sản xuất vải địa kỹ
thuật APT tại Khu công nghiệp Hải Sơn – huyện Đức Hoà, tỉnh Long An. Sự thành lập nhà máy vải địa là
mong muốn của chúng tôi mang đến Quý khách hàng những sản phẩm đạt chất lượng quốc tế với giá thành
hợp lý, góp phần vào công cuộc xây dựng hệ thống cơ sở hạ tầng tại Việt Nam.

Tháng 07/2020, để đáp ứng nhu cầu của khách hàng, chúng tôi đã mở rộng quy mô sản xuất bằng cách xây
dựng nhà máy sản xuất thứ 2 – Công ty TNHH xơ sợi An Thái với diện tích 30.000 m² tại Khu Công
Nghiệp Hải Sơn, Huyện Đức Hòa, Tỉnh Long An.

#### **CÔNG TY THÁI CHÂU – NHÀ MÁY VẢI ĐỊA KỸ THUẬT APT**

**NHÀ SẢN XUẤT CÁC SẢN PHẨM ĐỊA KỸ THUẬT HÀNG ĐẦU TẠI VIỆT NAM**

[ XEM THÊM ][36][ LIÊN HỆ VỚI CHÚNG TÔI ][37]

**Hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực sản xuất sản phẩm địa kỹ thuật tại Việt Nam**

[ Yêu cầu báo giá ][38]

### ****VỀ CHÚNG TÔI****

*Công ty TNHH XNK Thái Châu được thành lập vào ngày 25 tháng 06 năm 2005. Với hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm
trong lĩnh vực sản xuất sản phẩm địa kỹ thuật cho các công trình xây dựng như: vải địa kỹ thuật, bấc
thấm, màng GCL, Geotube, Geocell, màng chống thấm HDPE, lưới địa kỹ thuật… Chúng tôi không ngừng
nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ, mang đến những giá trị tốt nhất cho Quý khách hàng.*

Hiện Thái Châu là nhà sản xuất các sản phẩm địa kỹ thuật hàng đầu tại  Việt Nam.
Với sự phát triển không ngừng, vào cuối năm 2015 chúng tôi đã thành lập Nhà máy sản xuất vải địa kỹ
thuật APT tại Khu công nghiệp Hải Sơn – huyện Đức Hoà, tỉnh Long An. Sự thành lập nhà máy vải địa là
mong muốn của chúng tôi mang đến Quý khách hàng những sản phẩm đạt chất lượng quốc tế với giá thành
hợp lý, góp phần vào công cuộc xây dựng hệ thống cơ sở hạ tầng tại Việt Nam.

Tháng 07/2020, để đáp ứng nhu cầu của khách hàng, chúng tôi đã mở rộng quy mô sản xuất bằng cách xây
dựng nhà máy sản xuất thứ 2 – Công ty TNHH xơ sợi An Thái với diện tích 30.000 m² tại Khu Công
Nghiệp Hải Sơn, Huyện Đức Hòa, Tỉnh Long An.

### ****Nhà Máy Sản Xuất Xơ Polypropylene****

Xơ Polypropylene APT có lực kéo cao, cường độ kéo dãn thấp, sự tơi xốp tốt vì vậy phù hợp cho việc
kéo chải

Nhà máy xơ APT có thể sản xuất xơ Staple Virgin Polypropylen theo như yêu cầu của khách hàng, gồm
màu đen và trắng, kích thước dựa theo yêu cầu.

[ Xem thêm ][40]

### ****NHÀ MÁY SẢN XUẤT VẢI KHÔNG DỆT PET SPUNBOND****

**Thái Châu** là đơn vị đầu tiên của Việt Nam sản xuất vải không dệt PET Spunbond.

**Vải không dệt PET Spunbond** được sản xuất bằng chip polyester nguyên sinh thông qua các quy trình
kéo sợi nóng chảy, lực kéo tốc độ cao và kết tinh làm mát. Nó được đặc trưng bởi độ bền cao, khả
năng chịu nhiệt độ cao (trên 180 ℃), chống lão hóa và ổn định.

Báo giá vải PET spunbond:  [**0939.595.299
**][41]

[ Xem thêm ][42]

[

### VẢI ĐỊA KỸ THUẬT KHÔNG DỆT APT

Sản xuất hoàn toàn trên dây chuyền tự động với công nghệ Hàn Quốc, sử dụng 100% nguyên liệu
polypropylene, xuyên kim có phụ gia kháng tia cực tím.

[ Xem thêm ][44]
[
][45]

### VẢI ĐỊA KỸ THUẬT DỆT DML

Do nhà máy APT sản xuất trên dây chuyền tự động theo tiêu chuẩn công nghệ Hàn Quốc, sử dụng 100%
nguyên liệu từ Polyester.

[ Xem thêm ][46]
[
][47]

### BẤC THẤM

Bấc thấm APT với nguồn nguyên liệu chất lượng cao, nhập khẩu từ nước ngoài. Khả năng chống mài mòn
cực tốt, giá thành hợp lý với chất lượng quốc tế.

[ Xem thêm ][48]
[
][49]

### MÀNG CHỐNG THẤM BENTONITE

Sản xuất theo công nghệ dệt xuyên kim, giá thành hợp lý với chất lượng quốc tế.

[ Xem thêm ][50]
[
][51]

### LƯỚI ĐỊA KỸ THUẬT

Lưới địa APT đa dạng các sản phẩm lưới: lưới PP, lưới PET, lưới cốt sợi thủy tinh, lưới ô hình chữ
nhật,
lưới tam giác.

[ Xem thêm ][52]
[
][53]

### Ô ĐỊA KỸ THUẬT – GEOCELL

Được tạo thành từ những tấm HDPE liền kề và liên tục được hàn nhiệt với nhau, những ô này sau khi
được đổ đất/đá/sỏi sẽ tạo thành một kết cấu có khả năng gia cường nền đất, mái dốc nhằm chống xói
mòn.

[ Xem thêm ][54]
[
[HDPE geomembrane liner with high impermeability for landfill, pond, and waterproofing applications]
][55]

### MÀNG CHỐNG THẤM HDPE

Sản xuất từ hạt nhựa HDPE với mật độ cao (>0.94g/cm3), có độ dày từ 0.3mm – 3.0mm, đang được sử dụng
nhiều nhất trên thị trường hiện nay.

[ Xem thêm ][56]
[
][57]

### ỐNG ĐỊA KỸ THUẬT – GEOTUBE

Được làm từ vải địa kỹ thuật dệt cường lực cao Polyester hoặc Polypropylene khả năng kháng chịu được
môi trường nước biển, kháng tia cực tím (UV), chịu được độ pH.

*Công ty TNHH XNK Thái Châu được thành lập vào ngày 25 tháng 06 năm 2005. Với hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm

thuật APT tại Khu công nghiệp Hải Sơn – huyện Đức Hoà, tỉnh Long An. Sự thành lập nhà máy vải địa là

hợp lý, góp phần vào công cuộc xây dựng hệ thống cơ sở hạ tầng tại Việt Nam.

dựng nhà máy sản xuất thứ 2 – Công ty TNHH xơ sợi An Thái với diện tích 30.000 m² tại Khu Công
Nghiệp Hải Sơn, Huyện Đức Hòa, Tỉnh Long An.

Financial intelligence

## Financials, decoded.

Audited filings turned into three full statements, 32 ratios and a 0-100 Financial Health Score
across 8 dimensions, for every company, NBFC and LLP, going back up to a decade. Global sources do
not carry this depth for India.

#### Three full statements

Balance sheet, P&L and cash flow, standalone and consolidated, with the underlying filings.

#### 32 ratios & metrics

Liquidity, leverage, profitability, efficiency and returns, computed for every financial year.

#### Up to 10 years of history

Revenue, profit, net worth and assets with 1–10 year CAGR and trend insights.

#### Financial Health Score

A 0–100 score across 8 dimensions, with auto-generated risk factors and strengths.

#### Company, NBFC & LLP formats

Format-aware schemas so every entity type reads correctly, not forced into one template.

#### Peer & 4-way comparison

Benchmark against algorithmic peers, or compare up to four companies side by side.

Risk & compliance

## Know the risk before you commit.

The signals that matter for credit, onboarding and due diligence, pulled from courts, regulators and
registries, in one view.

#### Charges & borrowings

Open and closed charges, lenders, instruments and the exact property under charge.

#### Litigation across 5 forums

District, High & Supreme courts, NCLT and NCLAT, with hearings, orders and FIRs.

#### Regulatory actions

SEBI and RBI enforcement against companies and the people behind them.

#### Credit ratings & alerts

Ratings from CRISIL, ICRA, CARE and more, with upgrade and downgrade alerts.

#### GST & EPFO discipline

Filing and payment punctuality, MSME dues and on-time rates, month by month.

#### Auditor & CARO signals

Auditor qualifications, ~40 CARO disclosures, resignations and struck-off flags.

Indian Legal Entity Reports: ready in minutes, built for decisions

Get a comprehensive, structured report for any Indian company: identity, directors & KMP, ownership,
financials, charges, compliance, alerts, and litigation, compiled from MCA filings, courts, GST,
EPFO and rating agencies into a clean, printable format.

### What's inside the report

Built to match real-world workflows: research, due diligence, credit checks, vendor onboarding,
compliance screening, and risk review.

#### Company identity & snapshot

CIN/PAN, ROC, incorporation, status, contact, business segment.

#### Directors & KMP

Current & past directors, KMP, director profiles and affiliations.

#### Ownership & control

Shareholding, promoter/public split, director holdings, FIIs, group structure, ODI.

#### Financials & ratios

Balance sheet, P&L, cash flow, 32 ratios across up to 10 years, auditors & CARO.

#### Charges, peers & related corporates

Open/closed charges, peer comparison, and potentially related entities.

#### Compliance, alerts & risk signals

Regulatory alerts + GST/EPFO/CSR/Credit rating & other compliance checks.

#### Litigation intelligence

Pending & disposed cases, filed by or against the company (where available).

# Técnicas de Instalación y Geosintéticos, TINGEO

[ Contactar ][12]

## Quiénes somos

TINGEO es una empresa especializada en el asesoramiento y **construcción de Sistemas de Contención
Segura** mediante el empleo de materiales geosintéticos cuyos primeros pasos se iniciaron a finales
de los 80.

Parte fundamental de cualquier proyecto de instalación de geosintéticos consiste en la correcta
evaluación de los riesgos y acciones particulares del mismo, de manera que se puedan adaptar las
distintas soluciones a cada situación concreta, seleccionando los materiales, detalles constructivos
y procedimientos de ejecución que garanticen la seguridad y durabilidad del proyecto.

No existen soluciones válidas para todas las situaciones, estando el éxito, el fracaso, y la
eficiencia del proyecto, en los detalles y pequeñas diferencias.

## Qué nos diferencia

## ¿Cómo trabajamos?

TINGEO aplica en los proyectos en los que participa la combinación de:

##### Mejoras tecnológicas disponibles

Tanto en materiales geosintéticos, maquinaría de instalación, como en procedimientos de ejecución.

##### Amplia experiencia en instalación de Geosintéticos en todo tipo de obras

Acumulando el conocimiento de soluciones a distintos retos de muy diversas formas.

##### Décadas ofreciendo soluciones con geosintéticos

Nos han permitido conocer la evolución en el tiempo de las distintas soluciones posibilitando
analizar los puntos fuertes y débiles de las mismas a medio y largo plazo.

##### Departamento de ingeniería

Proveer más soluciones para la implementación de un sistema de contención segura.

##### Departamento de producción

Los compromisos con los plazos de ejecución son parte fundamental de nuestro trabajo, y hacemos de
ello una prioridad.

TINGEO colabora activamente con los distintos actores implicados en los sistemas de contención

Intercambiando información sobre el comportamiento de los productos y las necesidades no cubiertas
por los productos actuales, promoviendo modificaciones y nuevos desarrollos que serán los
geosintéticos del mañana.

### Maquinaria de soldadura

Con los que analizamos el comportamiento de los robots de soldadura bajo distintas condiciones
atmosféricas y características orográficas y ponemos a prueba los nuevos desarrollos.

### Ingenierías y administraciones

Compartiendo todo nuestro conocimiento en la planificación de nuevas instalaciones que den
soluciones eficientes y adecuadas a necesidades de interés público o privado.

Con las que colaboramos activamente en la definición de recomendaciones y exigencias, sobre el

# Técnicas de Instalación y Geosintéticos, TINGEO

[ Contactar ][12]

## Quiénes somos

TINGEO es una empresa especializada en el asesoramiento y **construcción de Sistemas de Contención
Segura** mediante el empleo de materiales geosintéticos cuyos primeros pasos se iniciaron a finales
de los 80.

Parte fundamental de cualquier proyecto de instalación de geosintéticos consiste en la correcta
evaluación de los riesgos y acciones particulares del mismo, de manera que se puedan adaptar las
distintas soluciones a cada situación concreta, seleccionando los materiales, detalles constructivos
y procedimientos de ejecución que garanticen la seguridad y durabilidad del proyecto.

No existen soluciones válidas para todas las situaciones, estando el éxito, el fracaso, y la
eficiencia del proyecto, en los detalles y pequeñas diferencias.

Acumulando el conocimiento de soluciones a distintos retos de muy diversas formas.

Nos han permitido conocer la evolución en el tiempo de las distintas soluciones posibilitando

##### Departamento de ingeniería

Proveer más soluciones para la implementación de un sistema de contención segura.

##### Departamento de producción

Los compromisos con los plazos de ejecución son parte fundamental de nuestro trabajo, y hacemos de

## Let’s build a better way forward

### We are a North American leader in the supply, installation and fabrication of high-quality
### geosynthetics and specialty civil engineering construction products that help manage the
### environment and prolong the life of critical infrastructure.

We offer a range of innovative, low-impact and cost-effective solutions designed to protect soil,
water, and air, and reduce carbon footprint. Our products are used in civil, environmental, and
geotechnical projects in a variety of sectors, including Civil Infrastructure, Water and Wastewater
Management, Mining, Oil and Gas, Hydroelectric, Agriculture and Sports & Recreation. We pride
ourselves on three principles of Trust. Quality. Value, putting client relationships, superior
products, and value at the forefront of what we do.
[Contact Us][54]

## Featured Tool: Titan Road Design Calculator

The Titan Road Design Calculator is a powerful online design tool built to simplify
geogrid-supported roadway design for engineers, contractors, and project owners. Using
industry-recognized methodologies—including Giroud-Han for unpaved roads and Modified AASHTO 1993
for paved and unpaved applications—the calculator delivers instant design calculations and
reinforcement recommendations based on your project-specific inputs. Generate detailed PDF design
summaries and optimize aggregate thickness with confidence. Whether you’re designing haul roads,
access roads, working platforms, or permanent pavements, the Calculator helps you make faster,
smarter, and more cost-effective design decisions.

[Try the Calculator][55]

## 20 Years of Titan:

For over two decades, Titan has grown from a small installation team into a trusted provider of
geosynthetic, environmental, and infrastructure solutions across North America. Built on a
foundation of problem-solving, technical expertise, and strong partnerships, we help customers
protect critical infrastructure, manage water and containment challenges, and stabilize land for
long-term performance. As we celebrate 20 years, we remain focused on delivering practical,
engineered solutions that perform in the field—today and into the future.

## Let’s build a better way forward

We offer a range of innovative, low-impact and cost-effective solutions designed to protect soil,
water, and air, and reduce carbon footprint. Our products are used in civil, environmental, and
geotechnical projects in a variety of sectors, including Civil Infrastructure, Water and Wastewater
Management, Mining, Oil and Gas, Hydroelectric, Agriculture and Sports & Recreation. We pride
ourselves on three principles of Trust. Quality. Value, putting client relationships, superior
products, and value at the forefront of what we do.

## Featured Tool: Titan Road Design Calculator

The Titan Road Design Calculator is a powerful online design tool built to simplify
geogrid-supported roadway design for engineers, contractors, and project owners. Using
industry-recognized methodologies—including Giroud-Han for unpaved roads and Modified AASHTO 1993
for paved and unpaved applications—the calculator delivers instant design calculations and
reinforcement recommendations based on your project-specific inputs. Generate detailed PDF design
summaries and optimize aggregate thickness with confidence. Whether you’re designing haul roads,
access roads, working platforms, or permanent pavements, the Calculator helps you make faster,
smarter, and more cost-effective design decisions.

[Try the Calculator][55]

## 20 Years of Titan:

For over two decades, Titan has grown from a small installation team into a trusted provider of
geosynthetic, environmental, and infrastructure solutions across North America. Built on a
foundation of problem-solving, technical expertise, and strong partnerships, we help customers
protect critical infrastructure, manage water and containment challenges, and stabilize land for
long-term performance. As we celebrate 20 years, we remain focused on delivering practical,
engineered solutions that perform in the field—today and into the future.

### Welcome to tynod geosynthetics

Tynod Geosynthetics specialize in providing a complete range of geosynthetic solutions designed to
meet the evolving needs of construction, civil engineering, and environmental protection projects
worldwide. With over 15 years of industry expertise, we have become a trusted one-stop supplier for
customers seeking reliable products, professional service, and technical support.

Our product portfolio includes **geocells, geogrids, geotextiles, geomembranes, geonets, 3D geomats,
drainage boards, coir blankets, grass pavers, cement blankets, and more**. Each product is carefully
manufactured to meet international quality standards and is widely applied in **soil stabilization,
erosion control, road construction, embankment reinforcement, landfill lining, and water management
projects**.

We serve a global network of distributors, construction companies, and end-users across **South
America, the Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, Europe, America, and Australia**. By offering a
wide selection under one roof, Tynod simplifies the procurement process and ensures our clients
benefit from **competitive pricing, fast delivery, and dependable performance**.

Our mission is simple: to deliver **quality, trust, and long-term value** through our geosynthetic
solutions. Whether you are expanding infrastructure, reinforcing terrain, or managing environmental
challenges, Tynod stands as your reliable partner in building sustainable foundations for the
future.

erosion control, road construction, embankment reinforcement, landfill lining, and water management

[ Can fitness equipment be adapted to the standards of various countries?

[ Which countries are covered by the certification for geotechnical materials?

[ What are the practical benefits of industrial belt collaboration?

shortened delivery cycles by 30%.

[ What value-added services do overseas warehouses provide?
][52]

We provide 72-hour delivery, commissioning and maintenance services, and 48-hour response times in
Europe and the United States.

[ Stainless steel, fiberglass, and enamel water tanks: how to choose?
][53]

For the food industry, choose 304 stainless steel water tanks (corrosion-resistant and food-grade);
for outdoor underground use, choose fiberglass reinforced plastic water tanks (lightweight and
aging-resistant); for humid environments, choose enamel water tanks (easy to clean and
rust-resistant).

[ How can I guarantee the condition of a used car? Can I see the inspection report?
][54]

All vehicles come from state-owned enterprise supply chains and undergo 32 tests (including engine
and battery life) before leaving the factory. A complete inspection report can be provided, and
video inspection or on-site inspection is supported (on-site inspection is available at overseas
warehouses).

[ What is the warranty policy for commercial central air conditioners? How long are the core
components covered?
][55]

The entire machine has a unified warranty of 2 years, and the core components (compressor, inverter)
have a warranty of 5 years. If you sign an annual maintenance contract, the warranty can be extended
to 8 years, and you can enjoy priority maintenance, parts discounts and other benefits.
